question: All the changes in climate and weather takes place in ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Troposphere**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The troposphere is the lowest layer of Earth's atmosphere, where nearly all weather conditions take place.
 
• It extends from Earth's surface up to the stratosphere, with its height varying from about 8 kilometers (5 miles) at the poles to 18 kilometers (11 miles) at the equator.
 
• Most clouds form within this layer, and it contains approximately 75% of the atmosphere's mass.
 
• Temperature decreases with altitude in the troposphere, leading to the circulation of air masses and the formation of weather phenomena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
Option

 
 
 
Details

 
 
 

 
 
1) Mesosphere

 
 
 
The third layer of the atmosphere, where meteors burn up upon entry.

 
 
 

 
 
3) Thermosphere

 
 
 
The second highest layer of the atmosphere, known for containing the ionosphere and where auroras occur.

 
 
 

 
 
4) Stratosphere

 
 
 
Located above the troposphere, containing the ozone layer which absorbs and scatters ultraviolet solar radiation.
